text_block_list.name: All the Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Delicious!" "It hits the spot~..."
"Seriously good!" "Ramen is the best!"
"Ramen Jamboree is the greatest!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I let out a sigh of relief as our third ramen event
seemed to wrap up successfully.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ......There were a lot of things to reflect on with this event...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes... Perhaps I failed to take into account that an ultimate ramen would require so many steps.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because of that, I kept everyone waiting
and caused unnecessary trouble...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "...However, the event is not over yet! We will turn things around from here!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes! You're right!
From here, we serve up 'seconds'—!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Helllooo, everyone! Have you all
eaten delicious ramen yet?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Are you full already?
—Don't you want... seconds?"

text_block_list.name: All the Fans
text_block_list.text:
"What's this?" "Hello-san?"
"Seconds?!" "There's another kind of ramen?"
"I'm full, but..." "Since we're here, why not!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Now then, please take a look at this!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—I'm running a race.
Get here as fast as you can to watch.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's not just Tokyo. The races will take place
at various venues across the entire nation!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Everyone with ties to the local community will be offering wonderful second helpings!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, we are Umamusume, right? When it comes to showing gratitude,
in the end... this is something you just can't skip, you know?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll do my very, very best!
P-P-P-Please take care of meee!!

text_block_list.name: All the Fans
text_block_list.text: "WOOOOOOOOOH!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fill their bellies with piping hot ramen!
And bring true smiles to their faces with a red-hot race!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Only by going that far can we deliver what
we wanted to give everyone—something that exceeds expectations!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"Now, please, dig in♪"
"This is our way of 'repaying the favor'!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"The Supreme Bowl of Ramen Cup"...
The Umamusume are in the gates—and now!
They're all off at once!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving up the lead!! I am the fastest, haah, haah!
*pant* *pant* *wheeze*! *gasp* *cough*!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You're truly gasping for breath, aren't ya?! But I'm not showing any mercy! Once in a while, even I gotta show off my time to shine!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I will... Even I will!
Catch up... I'm going to catch up to that back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Riding on the heat of the race, it reached me clearly.
Their feelings... directed straight toward their fans.

text_block_list.name: All the Fans
text_block_list.text:
""...Thank you."" ""Thank youuu!""
""Thank you for expressing your gratitude!!""

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
…………Ah, I see.
I think I finally understand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ramen is just like racing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Because with both... you can convey what
you want to say without needing words.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(In racing, with my polished running.
In ramen, with my unyielding devotion.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I can properly convey every bit of the "thank you"
overflowing from my heart!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be Fine-chan thought
that far ahead—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um, Fine-chan!
Could you be...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ramen and racing share fundamental aspects!
You knew that, which is why you chose ramen
as your way of giving back! Am I right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! I'm not thinking about anything like that~!
I just thought ramen could bring smiles to all the fans.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...?! You're totally right!
Maybe I was just overthinking things... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However... hehe. That's one way to interpret it!
Ramen really is so profound.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I thought I already knew plenty.
But over these past three years—I came to know even, so much more.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I guess I've fallen for it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I made some great memories!
I'm so glad I asked to stay behind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Top Road-san.
For helping me repay this favor together.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Seriously! Words aren't enough to describe
how much fun it was! Ahaha♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fine-chan...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Alright! Well then, let's get going. I have to live up to everyone's expectations right till the very end!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Thank you so very much for all your cheers!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufufu♪ But you're not satisfied yet, are you? After all, usually—a race is followed by an "extra serving"!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please enjoy♪
A rich and punchy—Winning Live!!
